description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_inflow_minmod.esm (model AdvectionMinmodInflow, test mms_steady_inflow_minmod) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway.
